about: Every known way a film has gone wrong, as a check a gate cannot pass without. tools/gate.py refuses a gate report unless each check that applies is pass, fixed (with a note) or n/a (with a reason). A director's note that was an error nobody's check caught becomes a new entry here (METHOD.md, phase 7). Seeded from LESSONS.md on 2026-10-19.

checks.title: Every time is measured on the master
checks.how: Beat grid from analysis/analyze.py (bar phase checked against the structure), lines from lyrics.json or the vocal stem; generator timings used only as drafts

checks.title: Downbeats sit where the music changes
checks.how: Section changes (bass entries, drops, breaks) fall on downbeats of the grid; on four-on-the-floor tracks the drum score cannot decide, so check against the structure

checks.title: Repeated lines are aligned where they are sung
checks.how: Repeats (choruses, echoes, builds) checked against the vocal stem's phrases; align.json windows where the alignment drifted

checks.title: Nothing sung after the generator's [End] is missed
checks.how: Vocal stem scanned to the last sample; whisper run on any late phrase

checks.title: Every sung line is readable, never covered, never ahead of the voice
checks.how: DIRECTION.md §4; lyric band contrast at its worst frame >= 4.5:1; skip when the film shows no lyrics by direction

checks.title: The glow layer is cleared under text
checks.how: Feathered clear under the lyric band and any slam

checks.title: Every glyph is in the bundled faces
checks.how: No missingGlyphs() warning in the render log; digits in a face with a plain zero

checks.title: Characters go through the frame's medium
checks.how: CRAFT.md §2: no figure reads as a pasted sticker at full size

checks.title: Characters meet the eight delivery lines
checks.how: CRAFT.md §10, checked at 2x zoom on the anchor frames

checks.title: Clues, props and characters read at thumbnail size
checks.how: Contact sheet at 320 px wide: name every clue and prop

checks.title: Three to five anchor frames look like one film
checks.how: LOOK.md written; opening, densest, mid-change and ending frames side by side

checks.title: Pictures stay on the look's palette
checks.how: tools/palette.py on generated stills against LOOK.md tokens; the accent marks one thing per shot

checks.title: Every shot has something alive and nothing boiling
checks.how: One main action plus 2-4 motif loops; no full-frame reseeding; watched at speed

checks.title: Camera moves vary
checks.how: No three pushes in a row; accents on at most a third of shots; every push-in has a way out

checks.title: Every cut has a carrier, a why and a landing
checks.how: Recorded in the plates table or scene bands; 2-4 transition families per film

checks.title: Shakes and flashes are capped
checks.how: DIRECTION §11: shakes <= 8 px, one per bar at most, flashes 2-3 frames, the silent beat untouched

checks.title: Recurring props and states match the continuity table
checks.how: Cuts sheet against the scene guide's table

checks.title: No render time past the take's end
checks.how: render.ts refuses such times; check the last plate's end

checks.title: tools/film-qc.py passes on the rendered film
checks.how: format, black, blank, frozen (the film's hold ceiling), cuts on the beat, loudness recorded, contact sheet looked at
checks.source: CRAFT §5, §8; mortiflix final pass; huashu film_gate

checks.title: Every final segment rendered on the same GPU
checks.how: The renderer string from render.ts gpu logged per segment and identical; frames either side of each join compared

checks.title: The final decodes fully with the right frame count
checks.how: ffmpeg full decode with no errors; frames = duration x 60

checks.title: Credits are exactly as the people credited asked
checks.how: A frame of the end card at full size, if the film has one
